name: Plausible Self-Hosted
description: Plausible Self-Hosted is the Community Edition of Plausible's open-source, privacy-focused web analytics platform, operated on infrastructure the customer controls. Teams use it to understand aggregate visitors, traffic sources, content performance and geography without a surveillance-oriented analytics stack.
agentUseSummary: Connect one current public HTTPS Plausible CE installation with a dedicated Stats API key and exact domain-style site ID. Selected agents can read four fixed bounded aggregate Stats API v2 reports under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions; Events, Sites, raw databases, visitor records, arbitrary filters and private-network endpoints remain unavailable.

credentialRequirements.name: PLAUSIBLE_SELF_HOSTED_INSTALLATION_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Plausible installation URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: The public HTTPS root of one current Plausible Community Edition installation. Private addresses, custom ports, redirects and embedded credentials are rejected.

credentialRequirements.name: PLAUSIBLE_SELF_HOSTED_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Plausible Stats API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: A dedicated Stats API key for the team that owns the intended site. Relay injects it only into the fixed Authorization header.

credentialRequirements.name: PLAUSIBLE_SELF_HOSTED_SITE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Plausible site ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact domain-style site_id configured in Plausible.

capabilities.label: Traffic overview
capabilities.description: Read aggregate visitors, visits, pageviews and engagement metrics for one exact site.

capabilities.label: Content and acquisition
capabilities.description: Read bounded page-path and traffic-source aggregate reports.

capabilities.label: Aggregate geography
capabilities.description: Read bounded country-level aggregate traffic without visitor-level location records.

approvalRequired.label: Read overview
approvalRequired.description: Read fixed aggregate visitor, visit, pageview and engagement metrics.

approvalRequired.label: Read top pages
approvalRequired.description: Read at most twenty page-path rows with bounded aggregate metrics and stripped query strings.

approvalRequired.label: Read sources
approvalRequired.description: Read at most twenty aggregate traffic-source rows.

approvalRequired.label: Read countries
approvalRequired.description: Read at most twenty country-level aggregate traffic rows.

blocked.label: Send events
blocked.description: Events API calls, pageviews, custom events, goals and historical event injection are unavailable.

blocked.label: Manage sites
blocked.description: Site provisioning, settings, goals, shared links, users, teams and API keys are unavailable.

blocked.label: Read raw data
blocked.description: ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, raw events, exports, User IDs, IP addresses and visitor-level records are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run raw stats queries
blocked.description: Agents cannot choose dimensions, metrics, filters, segments, date ranges, offsets, site IDs, URLs or arbitrary request bodies.

blocked.label: Reach private infrastructure
blocked.description: Private, local, reserved, link-local, non-HTTPS and redirecting endpoints are unavailable; Relay opens no tunnel and keeps the web backend on Railway.

blocked.label: Export unbounded analytics
blocked.description: Five fixed recent windows, twenty-row tables and 256 KiB responses are the maximum supported surface.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All private analytics reads require approval. Exact installation and site binding, fixed Stats API queries, bounds and audits always apply.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All four aggregate reads run without Relay per-action approval; exact authority, fixed queries, bounds, redaction and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway executes four fixed POST-only Stats API v2 queries against the exact public HTTPS Plausible CE installation and site, with SSRF protection, bounds and redaction.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer operates and secures a current Plausible Community Edition release at a public HTTPS URL, creates a dedicated team-scoped Stats API key, confirms the exact configured site domain, and enters those values in Relay. Keep CE patched, backed up and isolated; do not expose ClickHouse or PostgreSQL.

evidence.supports: Plausible identifies Community Edition as its self-hosted open-source analytics distribution, documents customer responsibility for infrastructure and describes its aggregate privacy-focused analytics model.
Current Community Edition release notes explicitly document Stats API v2 behavior, filters, metrics, date-range support and the /api/v2/query endpoint.
The official Stats API reference documents POST /api/v2/query, Bearer Stats API keys, exact site_id, metrics, date_range, dimensions, filters and pagination.
The legacy reference characterizes the Stats API as read-only aggregate statistics, distinguishes it from Events and Sites APIs and documents the default 600-request-per-hour key limit.
The CE configuration guide requires a BASE_URL and documents PostgreSQL and ClickHouse as customer-managed internal databases; Relay uses only the public HTTPS Stats API and excludes both databases.
